The '''Atrivis River''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Generis/Legends|Generis]]. [[Vistal Purn]]'s parents owned and operated a wilderness ranch on a white-water stretch of this river.<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
